svg.aria-label: Left: the 2-D latent means of 500 test bars, coloured by angle, forming a ring whose angle around the origin follows twice the bar angle. Right: a 9 by 9 grid of images decoded from codes between minus 2.4 and 2.4; going around the centre rotates the bar and going outward lengthens it, with blurred images near the centre
svg.text: decoded from a grid of codes, z from −2.4 to 2.4
